title: PortsStatusResult
description: Result of the ports.status JSON-RPC method: the discovery state for one authenticated target plus every forward the backend currently tracks. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

profileId.description: The authenticated target the status belongs to — the id the renderer echoes to every other ports.* method.

host.description: Remote host the discovery runs against, as the session opened it. Empty before the first connection to the profile.

discovery.description: The discovery read path: what the remote listens on and why we know (or do not know) it. A successful empty listeners list means nothing is listening; every non-available state means could-not-determine and must never render as 'no ports'.

state.description: Overall outcome of the last sample. pending is the state before the first sample completed; available with an empty listeners list means 'no listeners observed'.

listeners.description: Remote listening TCP ports from the last successful sample. Always an array, never null: an empty list is the honest 'nothing is listening' and must only appear when that is true.

family.description: IP family of the bind address.

address.description: Bind address as the probe reported it; may be a wildcard.

process.description: Three-valued process evidence: known | permission-denied | unsupported. Never absent — 'nobody owns it' and 'I was not allowed to see' are different facts and must render differently.

name.description: Process name; empty unless evidence is known.

pid.description: Process id; 0 unless evidence is known.

probe.description: Dialect that produced the last sample; empty when none did.

probesTried.description: Probes attempted for the last pass, in order. Always an array, never null.

classification.description: Human-readable why: refusal detail, truncation, tool absence. Never an uncontrolled dump of remote output.

stderr.description: Bounded excerpt of the probe's stderr, for diagnostics.

lastSampleAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC time of the last successful sample; null before any has completed.

paused.description: The user's Pause state: when true, no automatic samples run (manual Retry still does).

visible.description: Whether a watcher (the ports panel) is present and visible. Periodic sampling runs only while true.

connLost.description: The underlying connection died; discovery stopped and nothing samples until the next connection. A fresh sample follows automatically.

forwards.description: Every forward the backend currently tracks for the connection, running or stopped-by-transport-loss. Always an array, never null. User-stopped records leave the ledger at stop time — the renderer keeps those on its own side.

id.description: Backend-assigned tunnel id. The renderer echoes it to tunnel.stop; nothing else can stop a forward.

requestedBind.description: The bind the caller asked for. Port 0 means 'allocate' — the usable address is actualBind, never this.

actualBind.description: The address the listener really holds. Never the requested port when the request was 0.

destination.description: Remote target of the forward, host:port, as dialed over the SSH connection.

scope.description: Owner label the renderer attached at open.

state.description: Lifecycle state. A tracked record is running, or stopped by transport loss.

stopReason.description: Why the forward stopped. Null while running.

error.description: The error behind a stopped forward. Null while running or after a clean user stop.
